# Luw.ai

> > Free AI-powered home design platform offering interior, exterior, and sketch visualization tools for homeowners and designers.

Luw.ai is a comprehensive AI home design platform that leverages advanced AI models including ArchiGPT, Interior AI, and Exterior AI to enable users to visualize and plan home renovations. The platform provides both web and app-based interfaces with features like AI rendering, 3D modeling, mood boards, and automated design assistance.

## Key Topics

- Interior AI
- Exterior AI
- Sketch AI
- ArchiGPT
- AI room planner
- Virtual home designer
- 3D rendering
- Image generation
- Magic Prompt
- Magic Wand
- Room redesign
- Landscape design
- Mood board
- Design automation
- Free design tools

## Core Platform

- [Luw.ai Homepage](https://luw.ai): Landing page showcasing free AI home design tools including Interior AI, Exterior AI, and Sketch AI capabilities
- [Luw.ai App](https://app.luw.ai): Main application interface for AI-powered room planning and virtual home design with Persona system for personalized recommendations
